供养。消耗。吞噬。

供养。消耗。吞噬。

幻象不请自来。一颗颗星球化为死寂的灰烬，我们[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的肉身被灵能消耗，使这个声音……还有我们自己的饥饿……感到满足。

随着这些景象的展现，我们还能感受到另一种存在，它敦促我们要表现出克制以及与自己[Root.GetCitizenPlural]的团结，一起发展变强。那个存在被声音的嘶吼淹没。
texts.en:
From the abyss, a voice... resonant, coarse, and saturated with malice... calls out to us.

FEED. CONSUME. DEVOUR.

Visions erupt forth unbidden. Worlds reduced to ash and silence, the wails of our [Root.GetCitizenPlural] as their physical forms are consumed by psionic energy, satiating the voices... and our own... hunger.

As these sights unfold, we can feel another presence, urging us to show restraint and solidarity with our [Root.GetCitizenPlural], growing stronger together. It is drowned out as the voice screams.

texts.zh: 将他们的躯壳献给我！
texts.en: RENDER THEIR BODIES UNTO ME!

texts.zh: 将他们的血肉献给我！
texts.en: RENDER THEIR FLESH UNTO ME!

texts.zh:
被吞噬者的哀嚎响彻虚境和帝国两界，随后又突然落入了寂静。

以此牺牲，我们的力量随着饥饿的消退而增强。
texts.en:
The cries of the devoured resonate throughout both the Shroud and the empire, before they fall abruptly into silence.

With this sacrifice, our power grows as the hunger recedes.

texts.zh: 我们抑制了这个心声，团结一致地探向虚境，拥抱着自己的帝国。随着饥饿的加剧，众口一声地舒了一口气，舒适感淹没了愤怒的尖叫。
texts.en: We silence the voice, and instead reach out in unity across the Shroud, embracing our empire. A collective sigh of relief and comfort drowns out the screams of rage as the hunger deteriorates.
